prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental event piece about two galaxies approaching, distorting and beginning to merge. Around 100 BPM, F# minor. Two distinct string motifs in different keys lean toward each other; analog bass pulses like rotating cores; metallic percussion marks close passage. Kinetic and tidal, not militaristic. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No choir, use wordless synth pads only as atmosphere, never as a sung line. No trailer drums.

[00:00–00:30] Motif A left, motif B right, both slow, unaware.
[00:30–01:10] Motifs accelerate; bass pulses start; pitches bend as if tidally stretched.
[01:10–01:50] Close passage: metallic hits, overlapping strings, brief dissonance, then a shared pulse.
[01:50–02:30] A single merged figure, still restless, thinning into two lingering tails.
